title: Contract QA
description: A master services agreement plus a later amendment. Clause-level answers with citations — including the trap where the amendment supersedes the original (breach notification: 48h became 24h).
proves: Later amendment beats the original clause — with citations
questions: How quickly must CloudVault notify Meridian of a data breach?
What service credits apply if uptime drops to 99.5%?
What is the liability cap for data protection breaches?
Can Meridian terminate early without breach, and what does it cost?

prove_beats.label: as of May 2024 (MSA only)
prove_beats.question: How quickly must CloudVault notify Meridian of a data breach?

prove_beats.label: as of July 2024 (after DPA)
prove_beats.question: How quickly must CloudVault notify Meridian of a data breach?

ask_callouts.title: Supersession
ask_callouts.body: The DPA addendum shortens breach notification from 48h (MSA) to 24h. Prefer the later dated fact — that is the current obligation.
